questions.content:
(a) Explain the term biology

(b) Write down five importance of studying biology
i. __________________
ii. __________________
iii. __________________
iv. __________________
v. __________________

( c ) Differentiate Botany from Zoology

media.alt: Complete unchanged original biology paper page 4.

questions.marksProvenance: Printed Section B65; explicit source-guide Q3=14,Q4=8,Q6=4,Q7=14,Q8=10,Q9=4. Unique residual wholeQ5=65−54=11; not asserted as a printed main allocation.
questions.markIncrementProvenance: Independent half-mark self-assessment granularity; official substep increments are not asserted.
questions.answerKey: (a) Biology is the science/study of life and living organisms. (b) Any five: understanding and caring for the environment; identifying/classifying living organisms; understanding human bodies and health; acquiring research skills; answering biological questions; preparing for professions such as medicine or teaching; appreciating living nature. (c) Botany studies plants; zoology studies animals.
questions.markingGuide: Whole-main maximum uniquely reconciled as 65−(14+8+4+14+10+4)=11. This is a derived whole-question allocation, not a printed main maximum. Source guide explicitly gives five importance points at two marks each (10). Independent internal rubric: definition 0.5, five correct importance points 2 each, accurate Botany/Zoology distinction 0.5. No official a/c subweights are asserted.
questions.solutionProvenance: Associated Morogoro district/archive source guide checked against original question; independently clarified model wording where noted. Not an official NECTA scheme.

questions.answerKey: Eukaryotic cells have a membrane-bound nucleus containing their DNA and membrane-bound organelles; prokaryotic cells lack a membrane-bound nucleus and membrane-bound organelles, with DNA in a nucleoid region. Both possess a cell/plasma membrane.
